items.title: Sonny Williams Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: Satisfone player? Mm-hmm. Yeah, I know him. He's dead, ain't he?

ctx.x: Do you remember Pete Baddy? Baddy, no. Oh, yeah, Pete Baddy.
Mm-hmm. Satisfone player? Mm-hmm. Yeah, I know him. He's dead, ain't he?
I think so. I think his son played.
